list.title: Finance
list.description: Automatic Pix, payment links, recurring charges, and WhatsApp payment reminders.
list.cashflowDescription: Received each month and expected by due date.
list.empty: No charges yet. Create the first one in New charge.

new.title: New charge
new.description: Pix creates the copy-and-paste code and a payment link. With recurrence, the charge repeats on its own.

charge.title: Charge · {amount}
charge.fiscalDescription: Digital receipt, invoice (NFS-e), and Receita Saúde protocol.
charge.noReceipt: No receipt issued. It is created after payment.

dunning.title: Payment reminders
dunning.description: Sends a WhatsApp reminder for each overdue charge. Reminders usually recover about 70% of the amount.
dunning.overdueCount: {count, plural, one {# overdue charge} other {# overdue charges}}
dunning.sent: {count, plural, one {# reminder sent} other {# reminders sent}} (simulation).
dunning.empty: No overdue charges. When a due date passes, the charge shows up here.

tax.title: Tax
tax.description: Receipts, invoices (NFS-e, LC 116, code 14.01), and Receita Saúde protocols.
tax.rsBody: Since January 2025, self-employed health professionals in Brazil issue receipts through Receita Saúde (the Federal Revenue health receipt system). Salutti sends the protocol automatically when the receipt is created.
tax.withError: {count, plural, one {# with error} other {# with errors}}
tax.receiptsDescription: Receita Saúde protocol and PDF for the patient.
tax.noReceipts: No receipts issued. They are created when a charge is paid.
tax.nfseDescription: Issued through an invoicing API (NFE.io, Focus, or Nuvem Fiscal).
tax.certificateDescription: Required to sign prescriptions and invoices (ICP-Brasil).
tax.certificateBody: Upload the certificate in Settings; it is stored encrypted. Works with Memed, SafeID, and BirdID.

insurance.title: Insurance
insurance.description: Health insurers and batch billing in the ANS TISS 4.03.00 standard.
insurance.plansDescription: Each completed insurance session becomes a claim form in the next batch.
insurance.emptyDescription: Add the insurer on the side with its ANS registry and the contracted amount per session.
insurance.name: Insurer name
insurance.providerCodePlaceholder: Without a code, the CNPJ is used
insurance.providerDescription: Included in every claim form. Without a CNES, the form uses {cnes}, as the ANS recommends.

plan.title: Insurance · {name}
plan.subtitle: ANS registry {ans} · {price} per session
plan.generated: Batch {numbers} created. Download the XML below and submit it through the insurer's portal.
plan.toBillDescription: Completed sessions for this insurance plan that are not in a batch yet.
plan.ready: {count, plural, one {# ready to bill} other {# ready to bill}}
plan.empty: No sessions to bill. When a session for this insurance plan is marked as done, it shows up here.

tiss.noCard: Patient has no insurance card number.
tiss.notLinked: Patient is not linked to this insurance plan.
tiss.councilRequired: Insurance plans require the provider to hold a professional license (CRP or CRM).
tiss.dentalUnavailable: Dentistry uses the dental claim form (GTO), not available yet.
tiss.noGuideType: This professional type has no TISS claim form set up.
tiss.providerMissing: Enter the provider code at the insurer or the practice CNPJ.
tiss.noneReady: None of the selected sessions is ready to bill.
